summary: Next.js App Router integration package that bridges Barkpark's headless CMS to Next.js 15 RSC/SSR patterns — providing server-side data fetching with cache-tag management, webhook-driven cache invalidation, draft/preview mode, and SSE live-reload for editors.

intentions.title: Zero-boilerplate Next.js 15 data fetching with automatic cache tagging
intentions.evidence: server/core.ts builds URLs, resolves scope prefixes (workspace/project/dataset), and emits structured next.tags (bp:ds:<ds>:type:<t>, :doc:<id>, :_all) so fetch() force-cache entries are invalidatable at document, type, or dataset granularity without callers managing tags manually

intentions.title: Webhook-driven ISR: keep Next.js pages fresh when CMS content changes
intentions.evidence: webhook/index.ts (HMAC-SHA256 verify + dedup LRU) + revalidate/index.ts (revalidateTag fan-out) form a closed loop: Phoenix fires webhook → handler verifies → revalidateBarkpark calls revalidateTag on canonical tags → Next.js drops stale cache entries

intentions.title: Secure content preview via signed draft-mode tokens
intentions.evidence: draft-mode/index.ts issues signDraftModeToken (HMAC over path+expiry, 10-min TTL) and createDraftModeRoutes (GET enables draftMode, DELETE disables); core.ts branches on draftMode().isEnabled to switch to no-store + perspective=drafts + Bearer token

intentions.title: Live editor experience: SSE-driven page refresh without full reload
intentions.evidence: client/live.tsx mounts BarkparkLive / BarkparkLiveProvider, subscribes via client.listen() SSE, debounces router.refresh() calls; edge-runtime guard (three-layer ADR-005 detector) prevents misuse in CF Workers / Vercel Edge

intentions.title: Backward compatibility across scoped and legacy tag namespaces
intentions.evidence: Both server/core.ts (resolveTagPrefix) and revalidate/index.ts (tagPrefix) emit either scoped bp:ws:<ws>:p:<project>:ds:<dataset> or legacy flat bp:ds:<dataset> tags based on whether workspace+project are present, so old and new deployments interoperate

intentions.title: Secure webhook ingestion hardened against replay and timing attacks
intentions.evidence: webhook/index.ts uses timingSafeEqual for HMAC comparison, enforces ±5-min freshness window, deduplicates by delivery-id via LRU, and supports secret rotation via previousSecret fallback

intentions.title: Clean RSC / client-component boundary enforcement
intentions.evidence: server/core.ts imports 'server-only', explicitly does NOT export BarkparkLive (to avoid React.createContext in the react-server graph), and documents the split; client/live.tsx is 'use client'; separate subpath exports enforce the boundary at the package level
